blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Elections (Comelec) expects to complete the canvassing and announce the results of Saturday’s plebiscite in Naga City between 9 p.m. and 10 p.m., Nov. 21. The plebiscite will determine whether Naga will become a highly urbanized city (HUC). Registered voters will cast their ballots to either approve or reject the proposed conversion. Comelec Chair George Erwin Garcia said the city has around 128,000 registered voters, allowing the poll body to complete the canvassing within the day. “It’s not that complicated. …And therefore, we expect that on the night of the plebiscite, around 9 p.m., maybe […]...
